SOLE SOURCE CONTRACT – E2020 TECHNOLOGY, INC.
Recommending the Board:
APPROVE and FORWARD this report with transmittals requesting the Mayor to approve and authorize the President or two Commissioners of the Board to execute a sole source contract with e2020 Technology, Inc. for bureau-wide program management and document control system services with a budget authority of $4,156,000, which includes contingency, for a term of five years.
summary: Approval and forwarding of sole source contract with e2020 Technology, Inc. for bureau-wide program management and document control system services.
